name: Chilika Dhaba
area: Barkul, on the NH-16 approach road to Panthanivas
signature_dish: Chilika crab curry — mud crab in Odia-style masala
why_it_matters: The single most famous eatery on the Chilika circuit — a rustic roadside dhaba on the NH-16 turn-off to Barkul Panthanivas, ranked #1 restaurant in Khurda on Tripadvisor (3.6/5, 60+ reviews). It built a national reputation after being featured by Rocky and Mayur on the NDTV Goodtimes highway-food show and is the address most travellers are sent to for Chilika mud crab and prawns straight from the lagoon.
insider_tip: Always ask the price of crab before ordering — it is sold by weight and can run ₹1,200-1,500 a plate, and reviewers consistently flag bill surprises. Go at lunch for the freshest catch and skip weekends if you can, when crowds and waits spike. The prawn and fish dishes are better value than crab.
signature_address: Chilika Dhaba, NH-16 road to Panthanivas, Barkul, Khurda District, Odisha 752030

name: Panthanivas Barkul Restaurant (OTDC)
signature_dish: Prawn malai curry and crab masala with a lake view
why_it_matters: The in-house restaurant of OTDC's Panthanivas Barkul, the state-run hotel sitting directly on the Chilika lakefront beside the Barkul boat jetty. It is the most convenient lake-view sit-down meal for visitors doing a Barkul boat trip, serving Chilika seafood — prawn malai curry, crab masala, fresh fish — alongside standard Odia and Indian dishes at government-set prices.
insider_tip: Time lunch around your Barkul boat ride to Kalijai Island or Nalabana — the restaurant is a short walk from the jetty. Government pricing keeps it cheaper than the famous roadside dhaba; the prawn malai curry is the reliable order. Open to non-resident diners, not just hotel guests.
signature_address: Panthanivas Barkul, Chilika Lakefront, Barkul, Khurda District, Odisha 752030

name: Panthanivas Satapada Restaurant (OTDC)
area: Satapada, near the dolphin boat jetty
signature_dish: Crab curry and prawn malai curry by the lagoon
why_it_matters: OTDC Panthanivas Satapada is the only hotel right beside the Chilika jetty at Satapada — the launch point for Irrawaddy dolphin boat trips toward Sea Mouth and Rajhansa Island. Its restaurant is the practical lunch stop for the Satapada day-trip, serving seafood feasts and fixed-menu thalis; Tripadvisor reviews single it out as the best lunch option on a Chilika dolphin tour.
insider_tip: Book the boat first, then lunch — the restaurant is a five-minute walk from the jetty and the manager is used to handling tour-group crowds. Crab curry is the standout; vegetarians do well on the fixed thali. Satapada is the Puri-side approach to Chilika, separate from the Barkul/Rambha side.
signature_address: Panthanivas Satapada, near Dolphin Jetty, Satapada, Puri District, Odisha 752030

name: Panthanivas Rambha Restaurant (OTDC)
signature_dish: Prawn malai curry, crab masala and parshey fish fry
why_it_matters: OTDC Panthanivas Rambha sits on the quieter southern end of Chilika in Ganjam district, on a hillside overlooking the lagoon and its islands. Its restaurant serves fresh Chilika seafood — prawn malai curry, crab masala, parshey fish fry — and reviewers consistently call the food fresh, tasty and reasonably priced, making it the natural meal stop for travellers exploring the Rambha side of the lake.
insider_tip: Rambha is the least crowded of Chilika's three tourist bases — good if you want a calm lakeside lunch away from the Barkul bus traffic. Order the parshey fry, a small local fish most outsiders never try. The hillside garden seating has the best lagoon views; ask for an outdoor table.
signature_address: Panthanivas Rambha, Chilika Lakefront, Rambha, Ganjam District, Odisha 761028
